purpose: Test a market-explainable bull-market rotation mechanism before any future-return aggregation: when the broad market remains causally positive but its recent advance has slowed, an established stock leader may begin a second leg only if a controlled pullback is visibly absorbed. This is a mother-candidate and chart-discovery experiment, not a fitted trading rule or independent confirmation.
novelty_boundary: This is not another breakout, quiet-inventory, panic-reversal, support-hold, limit-up, true-gap, or generic trend-pullback screen. The signal is the same-session rejection of a bounded pullback low inside a causally decelerating bull market; the economic claim is rotation absorption, not raw momentum.

development_governance.chart_rule_source: all frozen candidates, each with approximately 126 completed market sessions before and after where available
development_governance.2022_2024_open_condition: Only after one chart-derived rule set is frozen and the 2014-2020 strategy has more than 50 completed signals in every calendar year and pooled mean net return above 4 percent.

causal_market_state.base_state: BULL at the completed signal close: market median ret20 and ret60 are positive and both positive-return shares exceed 0.50.
causal_market_state.deceleration: market_median_ret20 < market_median_ret60 at the completed signal close.
causal_market_state.economic_meaning: The broad long-equity backdrop is still positive, but the recent advance is slower than the medium-horizon advance; capital rotation and pullback absorption are more natural than a fresh indiscriminate breakout.

mother_candidate.universe: MAIN and CHINEXT, non-ST, fully hard-valid and tradable, with unchanged corporate-action coordinate lineage across every required history row.
mother_candidate.established_leader: At the close immediately before the signal, the stock has a positive 60-session coordinate return of at least 5 percent and no more than 60 percent.
mother_candidate.controlled_pullback: The signal-session coordinate low is 5 to 15 percent below the highest coordinate high in the preceding ten completed stock sessions.
mother_candidate.fresh_undercut: The signal-session coordinate low is at or below every coordinate low in the preceding five completed stock sessions.
mother_candidate.same_session_absorption: The signal opens below the preceding coordinate close, trades at least 2 percent below it intraday, then closes at or above the preceding coordinate close and in the top 30 percent of its own range.
mother_candidate.active_participation: Signal turnover is at least the median turnover of the preceding 20 completed stock sessions.
mother_candidate.no_price_limit_artifact: The signal close is strictly below the historical upper limit and strictly above the historical lower limit.
mother_candidate.deduplication: Retain only the first qualifying signal per symbol until more than 20 market-session indices have elapsed; no future observation is used.

candidate_stage.coverage_decision: If the bull-lane candidate density is too small to merit complete chart review, close this exact mother without attaching outcomes and move to a different economic mother. It is not required to cover bear years because it is intentionally one future router sleeve.

future_translation_if_chart_rules_earn_i.entry: first legal executable open strictly after the signal and no later than the third subsequent market session
future_translation_if_chart_rules_earn_i.initial_economic_profile: +10 percent gross target or H20 next legal open, 20 bps per side
future_translation_if_chart_rules_earn_i.bear_state: cash in this mother experiment; any later dual-engine combination must be separately frozen and cannot alter the bull chart findings

prohibited: future troughs or rebound labels in the candidate definition
threshold grid or neighboring lookback search
2022-2024 outcomes before the frozen development gate
automatic combination with a prior bear engine
